p.on('console',m=>{if(m.text().startsWith('__OBS_FLAGS__'))rec('ui-state-flags',JSON.parse(m.text().slice(13)))});for(const sc of scripts){if(sc.url==='http://127.0.0.1:8990/'){const ss=await cdp.send('Debugger.getScriptSource',{scriptId:sc.scriptId});const aa=ss.scriptSource.split('\n');const ix=aa.findIndex(l=>l.includes('saveBtn.disabled=!buyerMode||busy||!localReady||blocked;'));if(ix>=0){const q=await cdp.send('Debugger.setBreakpoint',{location:{scriptId:sc.scriptId,lineNumber:sc.startLine+ix},condition:'(console.debug("__OBS_FLAGS__"+JSON.stringify({date:new Date().toISOString(),mono:performance.now(),trialAtEvent:window.__obsTrial,busy,dirty,blocked,s4Available})),false)'});rec('flags-logpoint-installed',{location:q.actualLocation,sourceLine:aa[ix]});break}}}
await switchTo(idB,250);await switchTo(idA,1500);global.delayedOnce=false;await p.route('**/api/workspaces/*',async route=>{if(route.request().method()==='PUT'&&!delayedOnce){delayedOnce=true;rec('controlled-network-delay',{route:route.request().url(),delayMs:3000,purpose:'Repeat in-flight autosave observation with wait-for-handler cleanup'});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000));}await route.continue()});let waitSaveRequest=p.waitForRequest(q=>q.method()==='PUT'&&q.url().includes('/api/workspaces/'));await addTestItem('OBS01-AUTO-SLOW-REPEAT');await waitSaveRequest;await p.locator('[data-srm-v2-action="admin"]').click();await p.locator('#pilotS4DownloadFull').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await check('S05 disabled while delayed autosave in flight',await p.locator('#pilotS4DownloadFull').isDisabled(),true);await attempt('S05','controlled-auto-save-in-flight-repeat','mouse',1000);await p.unrouteAll({behavior:'wait'});await p.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('#pilotAutosaveStatus').textContent.includes('已自动保存'));await settled();await attempt('S06','after-delayed-autosave-complete-cleanup-awaited');global.finalState=fp('04-final');await check('other RFQ still byte-identical',finalState.workspaces[idB],seed.workspaces[idB]);await check('new material changes persisted exactly',finalState.workspaces[idA].snapshot.state.items.map(x=>x.id),['OBS01-FICTIONAL','OBS01-AUTO-SLOW','OBS01-AUTO-NATURAL','OBS01-AUTO-SLOW-REPEAT']);await p.close();await c.tracing.stop({path:root+'trace-part2-complete.zip'});await b.close();fs.writeFileSync(root+'runtime-driver-part2.txt',fs.readFileSync('/tmp/obs01/console-part2.cjs'));console.log('OBS01_28_ATTEMPTS_COMPLETE_TRACE_CLOSED');
